description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the rates of exchange effective from 28.05.2018 to 03.06.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically modifying how financial calculations are performed for import/export duties. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
